### 1 — Scene
A breakfast plate with scrambled eggs, fresh fruit, and a small portion of browned potatoes with vegetables.

### 2 — Vessel
A large, approximately square dinner plate, partly cropped. Using a **26 cm diameter equivalent** gives an estimated area of **531 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Visible foods: watermelon, honeydew melon, pineapple, scrambled eggs, browned potato pieces, a few green vegetables (possibly cucumber and pepper), and a small reddish sauce smear. Cooking fat is included in the eggs’ and potatoes’ energy estimates rather than counted separately.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Gross volume is area × height; weight is gross volume × bulk density.

| Item | Plate area | Area cm² | Height cm | Gross volume ml | Density g/ml | Weight g | kcal/100 g | Energy kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Watermelon | 18% | 95.6 | 2.2 | 210 | 0.60 | 126 | 30 | 38 |
| Honeydew | 7% | 37.2 | 2.3 | 86 | 0.65 | 56 | 36 | 20 |
| Pineapple | 8% | 42.5 | 2.0 | 85 | 0.65 | 55 | 50 | 28 |
| Scrambled eggs | 12% | 63.7 | 1.3 | 83 | 0.95 | 79 | 160 | 126 |
| Browned potatoes | 6% | 31.9 | 2.0 | 64 | 0.70 | 45 | 150 | 68 |
| Green vegetables | 2% | 10.6 | 1.0 | 11 | 0.60 | 6 | 25 | 2 |
| Reddish sauce | 0.5% | 2.7 | 0.3 | 0.8 | 1.00 | 1 | 80 | 1 |

The area shares total **53.5%**, consistent with a substantial uncovered portion of the plate.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimated **368 g and 283 kcal** are plausible for a fruit-heavy plate with a modest egg portion and a few potatoes. The cropped upper edge and uncertain cooking fat make roughly **300–450 g and 230–380 kcal** a reasonable range.
